description: SQL-DEMAND and PAR-ERROR, missing variant: the recordset events around a failing row. Bad has z = 0 at id 3 of 5. Each of SELECT id, 1/z AS e (static and forward-only), WHERE 1/z > 0 (static), TOP 2 and TOP 4 over SELECT id, 1/z ORDER BY id (static), and Sum(1/z) (static) is opened on its own ADODB.Recordset with the sink connected to RecordsetEvents, then every row's fields are read to EOF (at most 8 rows). Asks whether the error is raised at Open, at a move, or on the field read, and which events (WillMove, MoveComplete with its adStatus and error, FetchComplete) mark the failing row. Follow-up probe (round 2) for SQL-DEMAND, R-PAR-1, PAR-ERROR; works on a fresh writable copy of fixture r-q2-expr-sql-main. Each DAO statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
